scope: All existing saved edge-frame PNGs from the two explicitly named completed hidden-soak runs only; no runtime, live capture, image modification, or new approval.
method: Exact indexed source sprites: each cell admits its own base pair (2*cell,2*cell+1), with or without native hover sprite14; every one of 2048 cell pixels must match. PNG bytes are independently reconstructed in memory from the bound raw indices and recorded grayscale palette mode.
limits: The supplied stable candidate has native legacy action-bar placement; an HD-anchor mismatch is a diagnostic and cannot grant or deny promotion by itself.
No complete action-bar cell matches at either tested anchor in any of these hidden captures. This confirms absence in the captured indexed surface, not the final visible wrapper composition.
Only first/last retained PNG frames exist for these runs: 6 of 13 samples and 6 of 239 samples. Unsaved intermediate samples were not visually reviewed.
The failed 114207 long run remains failed for its recorded cleanup errors; this review does not upgrade its soak gate.
The separately running 141501 long run and any future images are outside this audit and were not checked.
